description: Create a new signing keypair for API digital signatures. Supports ED25519 (recommended) or RSA ciphers. IMPORTANT: Save the private key immediately as eBay does not store it. To sign the calls eBay requires signatures on for EU/UK sellers (Finances API, issueRefund), set EBAY_SIGNING_KEY_JWE to the returned jwe and EBAY_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY to the returned privateKey, then restart the server.

signingKeyCipher.description: Cipher for the generated keypair, e.g. ED25519 or RSA

name: ebay_create_signing_key
